PN_reference.comparison_scope: Same tasks/model but new Reflexion C0 differs from old three initials; prompts, actual calls, feedback, public checker and fallback differ. Full workflow comparison, not a shared-initial or pure memory ablation.
PN_reference.cost_scope: Retained stream attribution including shared prefix once; discarded/unknown old requests not fully allocated per method; not current cash expenditure

conditional_additions.note: Continuation selected by public outcome, not by strict label.

limitations: One outer run; same task identities but different initial candidates and candidate counts.
Reflexion uses one C0 plus at most two reflection/repair rounds (<=5 calls), PN uses three initials plus three additions (<=6).
Reflexion prompt/few-shot, reflection information, per-candidate execution and last-code fallback differ from historical PN batch generation and first-initial fallback.
Public function harness does not add imports; official strict harness retains its own import prelude. A public failure may pass strict scoring.
Historical PN fee is retained-stream attribution, not fully allocated original campaign cash expenditure; new Reflexion reports every settled request.
Known development cohort; no same-initial memory-effect claim or repeated-run superiority claim.
